exact_locator.paragraph_or_text_span: There's currently no cure for atopic eczema, although the symptoms tend to get better as you get older. There are treatments that can help manage it and improve your symptoms. The main treatments are: moisturising creams, lotions, ointments and gels you apply to your skin and wash with ( emollients ) steroid creams, lotions or gels you apply to your skin ( topical corticosteroids ) Depending how severe your eczema is, you may also be able to try other treatments such as special dressings or medicines. A GP can prescribe some treatments, or you may be referred to a skin specialist (dermatologist). Living with atopic eczema can be difficult. If it affects your mental health, you may be referred to a mental health specialist. Information:
